brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road and into the book. In Chapter 3, the prince wakes Jemmy in the night to run away. Build their ride in a forest, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? That’s okay. It’s Road Map Day. Read each clue from the book and tap the thing it names. Then finish two sentences about the runaways.
extra: Add a Frog by the horse. Say why the prince once dumped bullfrogs in the moat.
step1: These are your four models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR: open your menu, click the Canvas tab, then pick our assignment.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click the Explore tab. Type Forest in the Filter environments box and click Medieval Forest. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Press the top button on your right controller and click Models. Put the horse between the trees. Put the basket and the cloak next to it. Put the moon up high.
step4: Point to the horse and say this out loud. The prince ran away because… and finish the sentence. He picked Jemmy because… and finish that one too.
step5: Stand back so you can see the horse, the basket, the cloak and the moon. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Move the tablet until it all fits, then click Take photo. Now click the Canvas tab and pick 18.2 VR · The Runaways’ Ride. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Last, press the Meta button and click Quit.
